svg.aria-label: 1. Bring your harness. Install Oh-my-pi (omp). Use existing sign-ins, or run /login inside Null afterwards. Managed by OMP: Providers, subscriptions and API keys. Their availability and terms still apply. Null looks in: PATH, then ~/.omp/bin, ~/.opencode/bin, ~/.local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin and /usr/local/bin Null does not install OMP.
